tldr: Morning batch (Aug 31): a quiet window on frontier releases — the fresh signal is tooling and policy. Claude Code's Aug 29 update ships async sandbox startup, a 4.5x smaller Linux build and per-subagent model visibility in /tasks; Glassdoor data shows employee reviews of AI turned sour (positive mentions 81% → 43%). YC's Garry Tan amplifies the pro-datacenter case ahead of CA Prop 45, NVIDIA brings data-center-class AI to the desktop with DGX Station, and LocalLLaMA users report Qwen 3.8 27B German output beats GPT-5.6 and Fable 5.
